import cmg_setup_attribution as a
system=platform.system();assert system in ('Darwin','Linux')
art=root/'artifacts'/system
art.mkdir(exist_ok=True,parents=True)
records=[]
for label in ('accepted-timers','candidate-timers','accepted-counts','candidate-counts'):
 arm,mode=label.split('-');src=root/'attribution'/label
 source=json.loads((src/'attribution-source.json').read_text())
 assert a.file_sha256(src/'source.tar')==source['source_archive']['sha256']
 for name,expected in source['edited_files'].items():
  assert a.file_sha256(src/name)==expected,(label,name)
 cache=root/'attribution'/('cache-'+system+'-'+label)
 assert not cache.exists(),cache
 cache.mkdir()
 log=root/'logs'/('attribution-build-'+system+'-'+label+'.log')
 plugin=art/('attribution-'+label+'.plugin')
 assert not plugin.exists()
 env={**os.environ,'CARGO_TARGET_DIR':str(cache),'FEREG_GIT_COMMIT':a.ARMS[arm]['fereg'][:12]}
 cmd=['bash','scripts/build_macos.sh' if system=='Darwin' else 'scripts/build_linux.sh']
 started=time.monotonic()
 with log.open('x') as stream:
  child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,cwd=src/'fereg',env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
  try: code=child.wait(timeout=900)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL);child.wait();code=124
 record={'artifact':label,'system':system,'command':cmd,'exit':code,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-started,'log_sha256':a.file_sha256(log),'source_archive_sha256':source['source_archive']['sha256']}
 records.append(record)
 (root/'attribution'/('build-'+system+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=1)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
 assert code==0,(label,code)
 shutil.copyfile(src/'fereg/dist'/('fereg_macos.plugin' if system=='Darwin' else 'fereg_linux.plugin'),plugin)
 plan=json.loads((root/('plan-candidate-'+system+'.json')).read_text());hidden=a.ARMS[arm]['hidden']
 baseline=plan['files'][plan['artifacts'][hidden]['path']]
 digest=a.file_sha256(plugin)
 assert digest!=baseline and all(digest!=r.get('plugin_sha256') for r in records[:-1])
 record['plugin_sha256']=digest
 binding=a.bind(src,plugin,log,baseline)
 # Separate source binding per platform in this shared local/source layout.
 shutil.copyfile(src/'profile-source.json',src/('profile-source-'+system+'.json'))
 (root/'attribution'/('build-'+system+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=1)+'\n')
 shutil.rmtree(cache)
 print('ATTRIBUTION_BUILD_ARTIFACT_COMPLETE',system,label,digest,flush=True)
print('ATTRIBUTION_FOUR_BUILDS_COMPLETE',system,flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,platform,signal,subprocess,sys,time
root,repo=map(lambda p:Path(p).resolve(),sys.argv[1:3]);system=platform.system()
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/'bench'))
import cmg_setup_attribution as a
from qualify_scc import HostMonitor,MacMonitor
protocol=json.loads((repo/'bench/results/cmg-setup-attribution-20261021.json').read_text())['protocol']
for name,sha in protocol['files'].items():assert a.file_sha256(repo/name)==sha,(name,'protocol file drift')
builds=json.loads((root/'attribution'/('build-'+system+'.json')).read_text())
assert [b['artifact'] for b in builds]==protocol['order'] and all(b['exit']==0 for b in builds)
for b in builds:
 label=b['artifact'];src=root/'attribution'/label;frozen=protocol['arms'][label]
 source=json.loads((src/'attribution-source.json').read_text())
 assert source['fereg_revision']==frozen['fereg'] and source['cmg_revision']==frozen['cmg']
 assert source['mode']==frozen['mode'] and source['arm']==label.split('-')[0]
 assert source['source_archive']['sha256']==b['source_archive_sha256']==frozen['source_archive_sha256']
 assert a.file_sha256(src/'source.tar')==frozen['source_archive_sha256']
 assert source['attribution_diff_sha256']==a.file_sha256(src/'attribution.diff')==frozen['instrumentation_diff_sha256']
 assert a.file_sha256(root/'logs'/('attribution-build-'+system+'-'+b['artifact']+'.log'))==b['log_sha256']
 assert a.file_sha256(root/'artifacts'/system/('attribution-'+b['artifact']+'.plugin'))==b['plugin_sha256']
if system=='Linux':
 job=sys.argv[3];assert job.isdigit();deadline=time.monotonic()+180
 while True:
  result=subprocess.run(['qacct','-j',job],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  if result.returncode==0 and 'end_time' in result.stdout:break
  assert time.monotonic()<deadline,'missing build accounting'
  time.sleep(5)
 fields={p[0]:p[1].strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if len(p:=line.split(None,1))==2}
 assert fields['jobnumber']==job and fields['failed'].split()[0]==fields['exit_status']=='0'
 (root/'attribution'/'build-Linux-accounting.txt').write_text(result.stdout)
 baseline=root/'runner-candidate/target/tmp/cmg-upgrade/diagnostic-candidate-Linux/run-0-0/results.json'
 cls=HostMonitor
else:
 assert system=='Darwin'
 baseline=root/'diagnostic-candidate-Darwin/run-0-0/results.json';cls=MacMonitor
started=time.monotonic();runs=[]
with cls(root/'attribution'/('host-'+system),8) as observer:
 for label in protocol['order']:
  assert time.monotonic()-started<5400,'platform budget'
  observer.check()
  arm,mode=label.split('-');src=root/'attribution'/label
  out=root/'attribution'/('results-'+system)/label
  plugin=root/'artifacts'/system/('attribution-'+label+'.plugin')
  cmd=[sys.executable,str(repo/'bench/cmg_setup_attribution.py'),'run',str(repo),str(root),str(out),
       '--arm',a.ARMS[arm]['hidden'],'--revision',a.ARMS[arm]['fereg'],
       '--source',str(src/('profile-source-'+system+'.json')),'--attribution',str(src/'attribution-source.json'),
       '--plugin',str(plugin),'--plan',str(root/('plan-candidate-'+system+'.json')),'--baseline',str(baseline)]
  log=root/'logs'/('attribution-run-'+system+'-'+label+'.log')
  tick=time.monotonic()
  with log.open('x') as stream:
   child=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
   stop_reason=None
   deadline=min(tick+1200,started+5400)
   try:
    while child.poll() is None:
     observer.check()
     remaining=deadline-time.monotonic()
     if remaining<=0:raise TimeoutError('fixed artifact/platform budget expired')
     try:child.wait(timeout=min(.25,remaining))
     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
    code=child.returncode
   except Exception as error:
    stop_reason=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)
    try:os.killpg(child.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
    except ProcessLookupError:pass
    code=child.wait()
    stream.write('ATTRIBUTION_STOP '+stop_reason+'\n');stream.flush()
  runs.append({'artifact':label,'exit':code,'stop_reason':stop_reason,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-tick,'log_sha256':a.file_sha256(log)})
  (root/'attribution'/('runs-'+system+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=1)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(runs[-1]),flush=True)
  assert code==0 and stop_reason is None,(label,code,stop_reason)
  result=json.loads((out/'results.json').read_text())
  assert result['status']=='complete' and len(result['calls'])==18
  observer.check()
print('ATTRIBUTION_PLATFORM_COMPLETE',system,flush=True)
